# Autodesk Construction Cloud

> > Autodesk Construction Cloud is a unified platform connecting preconstruction, construction, and operations with AI-powered tools for BIM coordination, project management, and data-driven decision making.

The platform integrates products like Autodesk Build, BuildingConnected, Autodesk Docs, Autodesk Takeoff, and Navisworks to support the entire construction lifecycle. It features AI capabilities through Construction IQ and Autodesk Assistant, serving contractors, owners, and design teams with tools for bid management, document control, model coordination, and facility management.

## Key Topics

- Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)
- Autodesk Build
- BuildingConnected & BuildingConnected Pro
- BIM coordination and clash detection
- Autodesk Docs
- Autodesk Takeoff
- Construction IQ (AI-powered risk management)
- Preconstruction and bid management
- Document management and version control
- Project delivery and closeout
- Facilities management and asset handover
- Navisworks and model management
- Construction technology innovation
- Subcontractor qualification and trade partners
- Daily reporting and field management

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Model Management with Autodesk Construction Cloud + Navisworks](https://construction.autodesk.com/products/construction-model-management): BIM coordination & clash detection with Navisworks and Construction Cloud
- [AI for Construction](https://construction.autodesk.com/workflows/artificial-intelligence-construction): AI in construction: Autodesk Assistant, Construction IQ & automation tools
- [Technical Customer Support](https://construction.autodesk.com/support): Technical support hub for Autodesk Construction Cloud products & resources
- [BuildingConnected Pro Product Tour](https://construction.autodesk.com/product-tour/buildingconnected-pro-product-tour): BuildingConnected Pro tour: bid management, leveling & qualification tools
- [Construction Data Insights Product Tour](https://construction.autodesk.com/product-tour/executive-insight-product-tour): Autodesk Build tour: predictive analytics, dashboards & risk insights

## Workflows & Project Management

- [Facility Management](https://construction.autodesk.com/workflows/facilities-management): Mobile-first facility & BIM asset management solution for building ops
- [Construction Closeout & Project Handover](https://construction.autodesk.com/workflows/construction-closeout-project-handover): Streamline closeout & handover with connected documentation workflows
- [Construction Daily Report Software](https://construction.autodesk.com/tools/construction-daily-reports): Daily report software with templates & automated real-time field reporting

## Learning & Training

- [Construction Master Class](https://construction.autodesk.com/master-class): Free online construction management courses: BIM, VDC, project management
